rows.description: A glass-cannon damage dealer with extreme power, very low survivability, and naturally evasive presence.
A resilient frontline defender with strong taunt and minor damage, healing allies with every strike while holding the line.
A volatile jack-of-all-trades with unpredictable performance, dabbling in damage, debuffs, and survival, always convinced to be the best fighter on the field.
Explosioneers are walking hazards—sappers who turn defense into opportunity. Their erratic strikes can bypass tanks and tear through low-defense foes hiding behind the line.
A high-windup marksman that prioritizes different targets, delivering burst damage while remaining fragile and low threat.
A potentially durable melee fighter with high survivability and taunt, delivering solid damage while holding enemy attention.
A fast, high-burst melee fighter that trades survivability for quick damage and being fully exposed after engaging.
A resilient melee fighter with medium to high taunt and the ability to apply some damage even to the enemy backline.
One half team buffer and also half glass-cannon, the Mystic is a versatile class that wants to stay out of trouble.
A slow, fragile backline buffer who empowers allies and blows away multiple targets if you give him the time to set up.
A fragile backline debuffer who weakens enemies with control and disruption, remaining low threat and letting allies finish the fight.
A resilient main tank with immense durability and taunt, designed to absorb damage at the cost of low offense.
